body.x: Samsung lunched its products at a press conference at '2014 International CES', the biggest IT∙appliances held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.Samsung Electronics president BK Yoon made a speech citing a phrase 'THE CHANGES AHEAD OF US HOW SAMSUNG WILL COPE WITH THEM', then ended up with a protective flexible home called as Samsung Smart Home.Following that, Samsung Electronics America president Tim Baster and executive vice president Joe Stinziano came up on stage.
